column1: # Latin-script words of the radio volume, in addition to tools/content/terms_allowlist.tsv (read by tools/content/terms_check.py).
# Columns (TAB-separated): word, kind (abbr | mark | name | symbol), explanation, reason. Explanation is «—» unless kind is abbr;
# an abbr may give several explanations separated by «|» (terms_check.load_allowlist accepts any of them).
# A word may be listed only once across both files: FM, I, Q, Wi-Fi and the units V/m, MHz, GHz, mW, dB, μs, ns are global or exempt.

column4: рівень хвилі відносно 1 mW: стовпчик, шкала частот, «Докладніше» глав `air`–`cliff`
